name: DashboardSwitcher
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/DashboardSwitcher
summary: The dashboards hub: one page that switches between every dashboard of the account. A `PageHeader` named Dashboards sits over the controls row: a grouped `Select` of the dashboards (Platform, Security, Business and Yours) with a chart icon, a Filter `Popover` that sets the shared Period with a `Badge` that counts it, and a Refresh `IconButton` in a `Tooltip` at the end. The applied period shows as a removable `Chip` that reopens the filter. Under the controls, the chosen dashboard: four `StatTile`s with a `Hint` each and the comparison period, a `ChartCard` with the dashboard's `Chart` and its tooltip total, and a `ChartCard` with a ranked `BarList`. Switching the dashboard loads its body (Skeletons in place); changing the period or pressing Refresh refetches it, holding the previous render. A dashboard that owns its period (Executive summary, Spend, Project status) hides the shared filter and its chip and shows its own quarter `ToggleGroup` instead. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: OwnPeriod
variants.summary: Executive summary chosen: a dashboard that owns its period, so the shared Filter and its Period chip are hidden and a quarter `ToggleGroup` takes their place in the controls row; the tiles compare against the previous quarter and the chart runs week by week.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The body of the chosen dashboard while it loads: the controls stay usable, the tiles, the chart and the ranked list render their own Skeleton in their final boxes, so nothing reflows when the data arrives.
